ideas.pitch: An end-to-end data analysis pipeline built in Python and Power BI that ingests raw supply chain datasets to identify high-emission shipping routes and optimize carrier allocation for carbon reduction.
ideas.problem_statement: Perform end-to-end data analysis on provided datasets to extract patterns, trends, and business recommendations.
ideas.title: Logistics Carbon & Cost Optimization Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the pattern of clear measurable environmental and economic impact seen in winning logistics analytics projects.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning and exploratory data analysis dashboard that predicts patient readmission risks using tabular health records and surfaces clinical explainability using SHAP values.
ideas.problem_statement: Perform quantitative and statistical analysis on a real-world dataset to build meaningful visualizations and actionable recommendations.
ideas.title: Clinical Readmission Risk Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes rigorous statistical feature analysis and explainable ML, ensuring high technical depth for data judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated data profiling tool that runs cardinality, consistency, and validity checks on raw CSV datasets provided by organizers, instantly generating comprehensive data health reports.
ideas.problem_statement: Cleaning, transforming, and preparing raw datasets to identify key insights and business problems.
ideas.title: Automated EDA & Data Integrity Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the foundational data cleaning and exploratory data analysis criteria required by the hackathon rubric.

ideas.pitch: An analytics dashboard that processes server access logs to uncover traffic anomalies, peak load timings, and error rate patterns using statistical thresholding.
ideas.problem_statement: Exploring patterns, trends, and relationships within raw operational datasets to drive data-driven decisions.
ideas.title: Server Log Anomaly Detection & KPI Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an instantly demonstrable, working live dashboard that handles messy operational log data gracefully.

ideas.pitch: A quantitative sports analytics pipeline that parses player tracking data to evaluate performance metrics under high-pressure scenarios.
ideas.problem_statement: Performing quantitative and statistical analysis to turn raw data into meaningful insights and recommendations.
ideas.title: Sports Performance Improviser Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced statistical aggregation and metric derivation, showcasing deep analytical rigor beyond basic aggregations.
